description: Ooey Gooey Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies 1/2 cup brown sugar 1/4 cup white sugar 1/2 cup browned butter 1 egg 1 tsp vanilla 1/2 tsp espresso powder 1 cup flour 1/2 tsp baking soda 1/4 tsp salt 1 cup chocolate (I used milk and semi-sweet) Let brown butter cool around 15 minutes and then cream brown butter and sugar. Add egg and vanilla.  In another bowl, mix dry ingredients and then add to the wet ingredients.  Mix until it’s just combined and then fold in the chocolate.  Chill for at least 1 hours but ideally around 3 hours. Bake at 350 for 9-11 min. #cookies #baking #recipe #brownbutter #baketok
